shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat package.json && echo "---DOCS---" && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
echo "===APP DIR===" && ls -R app && echo "===NEXT CONFIG===" && cat next.config.ts

find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -path "*getting-started/caching*" -o -path "*directives/use-cache*" -o -path "*functions/use-cache*" 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---getting started---"; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/ 2>/dev/null

f=$(find .next -name "*.html" -path "*server*" | grep -v not-found | head -1); echo "FILE: $f"; grep -o '

[^<]*

\|class="skeleton"\|Total Revenue\|Latest Invoices\|Loading dashboard' "$f" | sort | uniq -c

f=".next/server/app/index.html"; ls -la "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "===" && grep -c "skeleton" "$f"; grep -o '

Dashboard

' "$f" | head -1; echo "--- markers ---"; grep -o 'Total Revenue\|Total Invoices\|Latest Invoices\|

Revenue

\|Loading dashboard' "$f" | sort | uniq -c
